title: Grab a Baozi
description: Time your wooden chopsticks with razor precision to snatch steaming baozi dumplings off a rotating steamer before the timer runs out.
controls: Tap at the right moment to snap your chopsticks closed and pick up passing steamed buns for bonus streaks.

zh-CN.title: 夹个包子
zh-CN.description: 魔性搞笑手速小游戏夹个包子：盯紧热气腾腾的蒸笼，看准时机出筷精准夹起美味大肉包，连夹暴击超欢乐！
zh-CN.controls: 看准时机点击屏幕出筷夹取蒸笼里的美味包子，连续命中触发高分连击。
